specialty.read_terms: Please read and acknowledge the following terms before proceeding:
specialty.terms_disclaimer: Medical Advice Disclaimer: You understand and agree that TeleConsultations provides medical advice based on the information you provide. The physicians are not liable for any outcomes resulting from the advice given during the consultation. You agree to indemnify and hold harmless the medical professionals from any claims arising from the consultation.
specialty.terms_duration: Consultation Duration: Each consultation is strictly limited to 8 minutes of direct interaction with the physician, with an additional 2 minutes allocated for closing the session (10 minutes total). If you require more time, you may need to schedule an additional consultation.
specialty.terms_payment: Payment Policy: All consultation fees are non-refundable once the session has begun. If you experience technical difficulties, please contact our support team immediately.
specialty.terms_patient: Single Patient Policy: Each consultation is intended for one patient only. Sharing your consultation with others is strictly prohibited and may result in termination of your account.
specialty.terms_acceptance: I have read, understood, and agree to all the terms and conditions outlined above. I acknowledge that by checking this box, I am electronically signing this agreement.
